AND a.device_code in
#{item}
AND `year` = YEAR(NOW())
AND `year` = YEAR(NOW()) AND `month` = MONTH(NOW())
AND `year` = YEAR(NOW()) AND `month` = MONTH(NOW()) AND `day` = DAY(NOW())
${dataScope}
